column1: # cp/install with no arguments, or as the last path part of a substitution (IndexError before 2026-10-16)
# jq/yq filters are paths into the data, not files (false positive before 2026-11-08); file arguments still count
# heredoc bodies are data, unless a shell reads them
# Rust reads python code fed on stdin and checks what os.system runs (the Python guard read the body as data).
# shell keywords in front of a command (do, then, else, {) don't hide it (before 2026-11-10 they did: do sudo ran)
